content: चरणः, -णम् [चर्-करणे ल्युट्] .²1 A foot; शिरसि चरण एष न्यस्यते वारयैनम् <ls>Ve. 3. 38</ls>; जात्या काममवध्योऽसि चरणं त्विदमुद्धृतम् <ls n="Ve. 3.">39</ls>. .²2 A support, pillar, prop. .²3 The root of a tree. .²4 The single line of a stanza. .²5 A quarter. .²6 A school or branch of any of the Vedas; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} चरणगुरवः <ls>Mv. 1</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; <ls>Pt. 4. 3</ls>. .²7 A race. .²8 (In prosody) A dactyl. .{@-णः@} A foot-soldier. .²2 A ray of light. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Moving, roaming, wandering. .²2 Performance, practising; <ls>Ms. 6. 75</ls>. .²3 Conduct of life, behaviour (moral). .²4 Accomplishment. .²5 Eating, consuming. .²6 Course. .²7 Acting, dealing, managing, conduct. .²8 Fixed observance of any class, age (as priesthood <ab>&c.</ab>); .²9 studying under strict rules of ब्रह्मचर्य; विशुद्धवीर्याश्चरणोपपन्नाः <ls>Mb. 5. 30. 7</ls>.
